Cinnamon Coconut Keto Energy Bites
By: Kettle and Fire
Published: Tuesday, July 25, 2017 - 4:45am

Ingredients




½ cup coconut butter
1 cup coconut shreds
⅓ cup monk fruit sweetener
1 ½ tablespoons ghee
1 teaspoon cinnamon powder

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend on high for 1 minute, or until fully blended. 2 For garnish, place cinnamon at the bottom of the silicone mold. 3 Spoon mixture into the silicone molds and refrigerate for 1 hour, or until completely solid.

About

These keto energy bites are the perfect grab ‘n’ go snack to ensure you always have a keto-friendly option on hand! The cinnamon and coconut flavor is great for when your sweet tooth kicks in.
